text: Our town park has a new playground. It opened last week, and many families came to see it. There are two big slides, a sand box and swings for little kids. The city put new trees around it too. Parents can sit on benches in the shade. The park is open every day from morning until dark. Please keep it clean and take your trash home.

How to keep your plants happy in summer. Water them early in the morning, before the sun is hot. Do not give them too much water, or the roots can rot. Put small plants in the shade in the middle of the day. Check the soil with your finger. If it is dry, it is time to water. Your garden will thank you.

We went to the lake for our family trip this year. The water was cold but clean. The kids swam and played in the sand all day. At night we made a fire and looked at the stars. My son saw a big fish jump out of the water. We will go back next summer for sure. It was the best trip we had in a long time.

This soup is easy to make and good on a cold day. You need two carrots, one onion, three potatoes and some water. Cut everything into small pieces. Put it all in a big pot and cook it for half an hour. Add a little salt and pepper. Serve it hot with fresh bread. Kids love it, and it is good for you.

The school library will be closed on Monday for painting. Students can still take books home on Tuesday. We have many new books for young readers this month. There are books about animals, space and history. Come and see them. The library helps every student find a book they love. Reading every day makes you a better reader.

My dog Buddy is ten years old. He is slow now, but he still loves his walks. Every morning we go around the block. He stops to smell every tree. Old dogs need soft beds and a little more care. I give him his food at the same time every day. He is my best friend, and I want him to be happy.

Getting enough sleep is important for your health. Most kids need about ten hours every night. Try to go to bed at the same time every day. Turn off the TV and phone an hour before you sleep. A dark and quiet room helps too. When you sleep well, you can think better and feel good all day.

Last weekend our team played a big soccer game. It was hot, and everyone was tired at the end. We were down by one goal at half time. Then Maria kicked the ball into the net, and it was a tie. In the last minute, Sam made one more goal. We won! The coach said he was proud of all of us.

Do you want to help birds in winter? Put out some seeds and fresh water. Birds need food when the ground is cold and hard. You can make a small bird house from wood. Put it high in a tree, away from cats. Soon you will see many birds come to visit. It is fun to watch them eat and play.

The farm market opens again this Saturday. Local farmers will sell fresh apples, eggs, milk and bread. There will be music and games for the kids. You can pet the goats and the little pigs. Bring a bag for your food. The market is on Main Street, next to the old school. See you there!

Our new bakery opened on the corner. They make fresh bread every morning. The cakes are big and sweet. My favorite is the apple pie. The people who work there are kind and fast. If you go early, you can get warm rolls. It is a nice place to stop on the way to work or school.
